Fixed. In `src/rpn.py`, subtraction was reversed: `apply_op` returned `b - a` instead of `a - b`, so `"10 4 -"` gave -6 instead of 6. All 5 tests pass now.

You didn't say what was broken, so I ran the tests and fixed the one failure. If you meant something else, tell me what you were seeing. I haven't committed anything.
